content.title: How to buy 2026 Final Four tickets, NCAA basketball Final 4 tickets
content.text: March 28, 2026Updated March 30, 2026, 1:43 p.m. ETThe 2026 men's NCAA Final Four will take place in Indianapolis at Lucas Oil Stadium.Illinois and Arizona have clinched their spot, while the final two teams will be decided on Sunday.Tickets for the Final Four start at $466, while an All-Sessions Pass starts at $759.Then there were four.As March turns to April, the best of the best in college basketball are just two wins away from a National Championship.The 2026 NCAA Final Four is set, with Illinois and Arizona winning on Saturday night, followed by Michigan and UConn on Sunday.SHOP: 2026 men's Final Four ticketsThe best that college basketball has to offer is less than one week away, don't miss out on what's sure to be an epic Final Four experience at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis.Here is everything you need to know about the the Final Four including how to buy tickets.Shop 2026 Final Four ticketsFinal Four ticketsTickets are already available for the men's Final Four in Indianapolis. Final Four tickets start at $489, but an All-Sessions Pass gets you tickets to both Saturday's Final Four games and Monday's National Championship game. All-Sessions Passes start at $694.Who is in the Final Four?The first national semifinalists were decided on Saturday night and the final teams will be decided on Sunday. Here are the teams headed to the Final Four:No. 3 Illinois vs. No. 2 UConnNo. 1 Arizona vs. No. 1 MichiganShop 2026 Final Four ticketsWhen is the 2026 Final Four?The Final Four is scheduled for Saturday, April 4. A ticket grants access to both national semifinal games on Saturday evening. Final Four tickets start at just $489.Where is the 2026 Final Four?The Final Four and National Championship game take place at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis. The women's Final Four and National Championship game are scheduled for Phoenix.Shop Indianapolis Final Four ticketsWhat time is the 2026 Final Four?The Final Four games on Saturday, April 4 are scheduled to start at 6:09 p.m. and 8:49 p.m. ET. However, the second game usually begins later than the scheduled time, as the players are given a warm-up period after the conclusion of the first game.2026 Final Four game timesNo. 2 UConn and No. 3 Illinois will tip things off at 6:09 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 4. The top-seeded showdown between Arizona and Michigan is scheduled to start at 8:49 p.m. ET, but will likely start a few minutes later.National Championship ticket pricesThe National Championship game is scheduled for 8:30 p.m. ET on Monday, April 6. Tickets are already available and start at $267.Shop 2026 National Championship game ticketsMarch Madness 2026 full schedule for the men's tournamentMarch 19-20: First roundMarch 21-22: Second roundMarch 26-27: Sweet 16March 28-29: Elite 8April 4-5: Final FourApril 6: National ChampionshipShop ALL March Madness tickets
